channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: EXPLAINED: Who loves and who loathes France's 10,000 wind turbines
item.description: As France pushes ahead with its green transition, we take a look at the country's wind turbines - how many of them are there, how much electricity do they provide and who likes or loathes them.

item.title: Marseille mayor opposes Kanye West gig over 'unabashed Nazism'
item.description: The mayor of France's second-biggest city Marseille said Wednesday that Kanye West was "not welcome", after the music star known for his antisemitic rants announced a concert in June.

item.title: French Word of the Day: Groupuscule
item.description: This French word is tricky to translate into English, but is an important part of the French political discussion.

item.title: Fuel prices in France to rise ‘a few cents’ due to Iran war
item.description: Fuel prices in France are set to rise by ‘a few cents’ because of the war in Iran, but officials have said there is no risk of a supply shortage because of the country’s numerous import sources and stockpiles.

item.title: French policeman to be tried over 2023 killing of teen
item.description: A French policeman who shot and killed a teenager in 2023 outside Paris, sparking nationwide protests, will stand trial for violence that led to death, an appeals court said on Thursday.

item.title: 8 things to watch in France’s upcoming local elections
item.description: France heads to the polls soon for the first round of the 2026 municipal elections - here's a few things to watch out for as the race hots up.

item.title: Pollution exposure in Europe linked to mental health problems
item.description: Environmental pollution is linked to several mental health disorders in Europe, the European Environment Agency (EEA) has warned, arguing that enforcing legislation would result in Europeans being both less depressed and less anxious.

item.title: MAPS: How many Parisians live more than 5 minutes from a boulangerie?
item.description: Bakeries, butchers, wine shops and cafés - how far do Parisians have to walk from their homes to reach the essentials of life?

item.title: Water outage in your home in France - who to call and what to say
item.description: There are a multitude of reasons that you may come home or wake up to no water in your home. Here's what you can do if that ever happens to you.

item.title: How to arrange a proxy vote in France
item.description: France does not allow postal votes, but if you are not able to attend the polling station on the day, you can arrange for someone else to cast your vote - here's how.
